fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn using STRPluginMessagingAPI, with mandatory pre-UI consent, native multi-master scene controls, participant-authored OStim alignment plus clock-calibrated phase replay for free scenes, remote-proxy logical-origin correction, safe orphan proxy-thread cleanup, live OCum mesh-state tracking and 3D refresh, idempotent shared speed control, Skyrim-Souls-safe message boxes, and OCum overlay/equip-object synchronization.
